download_vendor_dependencies: download all vendor dependencies from remote URLs to local vendor directories
run_httplib_split: run the cpp-httplib split script to split httplib.h into cpp and header files
clean_temporary_files: remove temporary split.py and httplib.h files after splitting
update_vendor_versions: update vendor library versions by changing URLs and version tags in the vendor dictionary
verify_vendor_downloads: verify all vendor files are downloaded correctly to their expected paths
